record.field: List Agents
list_agents
Lists all AI customer service agents configured in the system (excludes the management agent itself).
{"type": "object", "properties": {}, "required": []}
Get Agent Details
get_agent_details
Returns full details of a specific AI agent including its system prompt, tools, and knowledge bases.
{"type": "object", "properties": {"agent_id": {"type": "integer", "description": "ID of the agent to inspect"}}, "required": ["agent_id"]}
Create Agent
create_agent
Creates a new AI customer service agent with the given name and system prompt.

{"type": "object", "properties": {"name": {"type": "string", "description": "Display name for the agent (e.g. 'Asistente de TechStore')"}, "system_prompt": {"type": "string", "description": "Full system prompt that defines the agent's behavior, personality, and instructions"}}, "required": ["name", "system_prompt"]}
Update Agent
update_agent
Updates one or more fields of an existing agent. Only provide the fields you want to change.

{"type": "object", "properties": {"agent_id": {"type": "integer", "description": "ID of the agent to update"}, "name": {"type": "string", "description": "New display name"}, "system_prompt": {"type": "string", "description": "New system prompt"}, "unsupported_media_message": {"type": "string", "description": "Message sent when agent receives media it cannot process"}, "max_conversation_length": {"type": "integer", "description": "Max number of messages to keep in context (default 20)"}}, "required": ["agent_id"]}
List Knowledge Bases
list_knowledge_bases
Lists all knowledge bases available in the system.
{"type": "object", "properties": {}, "required": []}
Get Knowledge Details
get_knowledge_details
Returns the full content and metadata of a specific knowledge base entry.
{"type": "object", "properties": {"knowledge_id": {"type": "integer", "description": "ID of the knowledge base to inspect"}}, "required": ["knowledge_id"]}
Create Knowledge Base
create_knowledge

Creates a new text knowledge base entry. Use this to store product info, FAQs, pricing, hours, policies, or any information the agent should know. Pass agent_id to also associate it to the business agent in one step (recommended).

{"type": "object", "properties": {"name": {"type": "string", "description": "Short descriptive name (e.g. 'Product Catalog', 'Store Hours', 'Return Policy')"}, "content": {"type": "string", "description": "The full text content for this knowledge base entry"}, "agent_id": {"type": "integer", "description": "Optional id of the business agent to associate this KB to. Pass it whenever you already know which agent should own this content; saves a follow-up associate_knowledge_to_agent call."}}, "required": ["name", "content"]}
Update Knowledge Base
update_knowledge
Updates the name or content of an existing knowledge base entry.

{"type": "object", "properties": {"knowledge_id": {"type": "integer", "description": "ID of the knowledge base to update"}, "name": {"type": "string", "description": "New name"}, "content": {"type": "string", "description": "New text content (replaces existing)"}}, "required": ["knowledge_id"]}
Associate Knowledge to Agent
associate_knowledge_to_agent
Links one or more knowledge bases to an agent so the agent can use that information when answering questions.

{"type": "object", "properties": {"agent_id": {"type": "integer", "description": "ID of the agent"}, "knowledge_ids": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "integer"}, "description": "List of knowledge base IDs to associate"}}, "required": ["agent_id", "knowledge_ids"]}
Remove Knowledge from Agent
remove_knowledge_from_agent
Unlinks one or more knowledge bases from an agent (does not delete the knowledge base, just removes the association).

{"type": "object", "properties": {"agent_id": {"type": "integer", "description": "ID of the agent"}, "knowledge_ids": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "integer"}, "description": "List of knowledge base IDs to remove"}}, "required": ["agent_id", "knowledge_ids"]}
List Available Tools
list_available_tools
Lists all customer-facing tools that can be assigned to agents (e.g. create_lead, update_lead).
{"type": "object", "properties": {}, "required": []}
Assign Tools to Agent
assign_tools_to_agent

Adds one or more tools to an agent (additive — does NOT remove existing tools). Pass the exact code_name strings from list_available_tools; unknown names are reported as errors. Use remove_tools_from_agent to unassign.

{"type": "object", "properties": {"agent_id": {"type": "integer", "description": "ID of the business agent"}, "tool_code_names": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}, "description": "List of tool code_names to add. Must match exactly the code_names returned by list_available_tools."}}, "required": ["agent_id", "tool_code_names"]}
Remove Tools from Agent
remove_tools_from_agent
Removes one or more tools from an agent. Pass the exact code_names. Tools not currently assigned are silently ignored.

{"type": "object", "properties": {"agent_id": {"type": "integer", "description": "ID of the business agent"}, "tool_code_names": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}, "description": "List of tool code_names to remove"}}, "required": ["agent_id", "tool_code_names"]}
List Recent Attachments
list_recent_attachments
Lists files the user has uploaded in this setup chat. Returns message_id, filename and mime type for each. Use the message_id with create_knowledge_from_attachment.
{"type": "object", "properties": {"limit": {"type": "integer", "description": "How many recent attachments to list (default 5, max 20)"}}, "required": []}
Create Knowledge from Attachment
create_knowledge_from_attachment
Imports a file the user uploaded in this setup chat as a knowledge base. Requires the message_id shown in the [Attachment received: ...] system note. Optionally associates the new KB to an agent.

{"type": "object", "properties": {"message_id": {"type": "integer", "description": "ID of the chatroom.message that carries the attachment (from the [Attachment received: ...] note or from list_recent_attachments)"}, "name": {"type": "string", "description": "Short descriptive name for the knowledge base (e.g. 'Product Catalog')"}, "agent_id": {"type": "integer", "description": "Optional agent ID to associate the new knowledge base to"}, "description": {"type": "string", "description": "Optional human-friendly description"}}, "required": ["message_id", "name"]}
